_comment: Narration lexicon (natural-sounding-narration-with-frankentts). words: names to respell for the TTS input only, every respelling auditioned, plus the ASR spellings that count as correct. accept: harmless ASR spellings of ordinary words. phrases: multi-word ASR spellings to normalize. Add every proper name and term of art in the script: look it up (lookup_pronunciation.py), then audition and lock it (probe_names.py run lexicon.json WORK --write) before the full run. say/decoy/note/probe document the choice; only respell and accept change narration.

manim.note: No source gives IPA (Wikipedia, Wiktionary); MAN-im is the owner's (math animation). Probed with ftts 0.1.11 robert + fw 0.10.0 f32 in 5 carriers, one of them this script's line 02_2: Man-im passed 5/5. Plain manim was heard Manning/Manum/Frank and Manum, and the decoy Men-em was heard Menem (the failure this entry fixes). Carriers (reproduce with probe_names.py --carrier): 'This is {w}.', '{w} showed something deeper.', 'The idea came from {w}, in the end.', 'It was rendered by franken {w}, and narrated by franken T T S.', 'It was rendered by franken {w}.'. The probe's 'man m' is left out of phrases: probe_names.py never locks a phrase with a one-letter token. 'manning' (a real name) is deliberately not accepted.
